verdict.rationale: The evidence implies monday.com boards are built from configurable columns: users can change column values, add actions to column menus, and new board column types can be shipped. Community users also describe it as requiring a lot of setup and customization, and as un-opinionated enough that managers shape the process themselves. However, no first-party doc says a product manager can define custom fields or edit workflow status labels in the UI, and custom column types are a developer path rather than a PM feature. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of user-defined fields and custom status columns/labels, evidence of configuring workflow stages per team, and hands-on corroboration of status customization.
